findings.title: The vault's own 429 message bypasses describeError: 'Too many incorrect codes. Wait before trying again. Try again in 598 seconds.'
findings.evidence: s10.mjs: after 5 wrong codes the alert reads 'Too many incorrect codes. Wait before trying again. Try again in 598 seconds.' (double instruction, raw 598 seconds for a ~10 minute lock, while the previous alert promised 'a short pause'). Generic 429s through describeError are clean ('Too many attempts. Try again in 60 seconds.', 'in 1 second'). Code reading (not reproduced): unlockMessage does not pluralise, so the last second would read '1 seconds'. Root cause of the redundancy in the generic path too: describeError strips only sentences matching try again|retry, so 'trying again' is kept. Screenshot /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r11-B/shots/s10-429-vault.png.
findings.expected: One instruction and a human duration; no 'short pause' wording for a 10 minute lock.
findings.actual: Redundant sentence plus raw seconds on the vault; inconsistent with the rest of the app.
findings.fix_hint: web/src/pages/progress.tsx unlockMessage (429 branch): delegate to describeError and widen its regex in web/src/ui/state.tsx to /\b(try(ing)? again|retry)\b/; be/src/game.ts:215 wording.

findings.area: describeError for 5xx with an empty body (ui/state.tsx, lib/api.ts ApiError default message)
findings.title: An empty-bodied 503 (typical proxy outage) shows 'Request failed (503)' in the new banner, the rules note and error panels; the friendly fallback in describeError is unreachable
findings.evidence: s1.mjs 503 case: banner '...preference is not applied. Request failed (503)'; s2.mjs rules note 'The scoring rules could not be loaded, so the hint price is not shown. Request failed (503)'. ApiError always sets a non-empty default message, so `error.message || 'The server had a problem. Please retry.'` never falls through.

notes:
Stack: own API 4801 (DEMO_MODE, NODE_ENV=test; restarted once with RATE_REGISTER_PER_HOUR raised) + Vite dev 4802, headless Chromium via Playwright; scripts, screenshots and logs in /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r11-B/ (shots/). Servers killed. NOTE: other waves apparently kill headless Chromium on this machine: three runs died with 'page/browser closed' at random points (s7, s11, fz) and were re-run to completion; none is a product defect (the same flows pass in isolation, s7b/s12).
ROUND-10 FIXES VERIFIED. Profile banner (s1/s2/s18/s24): 500/503/403/bad JSON/HTML 200/{}/incomplete/network abort each give one role=alert with Retry in the shell; the Learning settings page shows only its own panel (no double alert); Retry becomes aria-disabled 'Retrying...' and keeps focus; a failing retry re-shows the alert; a successful retry removes it, moves focus to the h1 and applies the saved Reduce motion (dataset.reduceMotion=true). Persistent 401 on /profile halts with the documented 'server keeps rejecting guest sessions' gate. Banner + failed-switch error stack with no overflow or axe violation at 320/375/1440. 401 during guest switch (s3/s3b): 7 timing variants (401 before/while/after a delayed /auth/demo 0.8-2.5 s, double click, reload mid-switch, failed switch + 401, faculty-session 401, faculty->student): the notice never leaks to the wrong role, no second recovery, no double session. Dismiss (s4): keyboard Enter/Space and mouse, 5 views x 2 viewports and 3 repeats: focus always on the h1 (never BODY), Tab continues into the page. /rules failure (s2): alert + Retry in the hint area, focus returns to the hint button, hint price returns. Long badge names (bc.mjs): wrapped at 320/375/768/1440, scrollWidth == clientWidth. Timeouts (s6, 6 scenarios with real 20 s timers): controls released at ~21 s; 'Checking what the server recorded...' status while the resync runs and cleared afterwards (also after 2 timeouts in a row and after re-submitting during a resync); Exit during resync leaves cleanly (no stale alert on the lab page); offline -> online resubmit works and the focus resync clears the stale alert; requestfailed ERR_ABORTED proves the timed-out POST/GET is really aborted; a processed-but-unanswered wrong answer and hint show the server state (-10 / -15, hint text) with the resync note and no double charge. 409 codes (s7): no_more_hints, wrong_step (answer and hint), attempt_finished (answer and hint on a stale tab show the result), time_expired in another tab (answer and hint -> Restart panel, focus on Restart), hint_in_progress (faked 409): all re-read the attempt and show server numbers. Start conflicts (s16: locked mission 403 'Complete mission 01 to unlock.', 500, 429, 200/201 invalid payload): dismissable alert, focus on the h1, no screen steal. Order boundary (o2, 4 viewports + reduced motion): aria-disabled stays focused, order unchanged on Enter/Space/mouse/tap, 'already in position N of M', axe clean. Return to mission control (s8): from dashboard start, lobby start after Progress, reload-resume and Lab results all land on Mission control with the h1 focused; Exit returns to where the mission was started; browser Back leaves the app (known). Dashboard overall (s9): 0/1/3/6/9/9/9/9/9 of 9 across 9 states, hero text and CTA correct, Labs cleared 0..3, 'All investigations complete.' only when everything including the Master vault is done, UI equals API. Generic 429 copy OK. 'Show all' 76x44 / 78x44. Lab results plural: '1 mission completed', '1 of 1 mission' (s13).
BROAD SWEEP (sw.mjs, fresh registered student: every mission start/hint/wrong/each step/result of the 3 standard labs, vault wrong+right code, lab results, map, lobby, settings, progress): 402 states at 375 touch, 320 touch, 768, 1440, 375 + reduced motion, 1440 + reduced motion: axe wcag2a/aa/21/22 + best-practice 0 violations, 0 mid-word breaks, 0 clipped text, 0 horizontal overflow, 0 offscreen controls, 0 touch targets <44 px, 0 raw ids/undefined/NaN; console only the deliberate 422 for a wrong exit code (visible alert). The Master mission itself was not played through the UI (covered through API + dashboard + lab results). Keyboard-only completion of point, decision, choice, order, matching (k1.mjs at 1440 and at 375 reduced motion): no focus loss, no BODY, ring visible, ISSUES []. Consistency (s11 at 375 and 1440, three missions with hint + wrong): status card = /attempts, result score/accuracy/ledger = /attempts/:id/result (ledger sum = score), fragment digits = /vault, dashboard XP = /me after every mission, lab results XP = API = /me.
PAYLOAD FUZZ (no plausible defaults): about 340 leaf paths of /dashboard, /labs, /me, /vault, /badges, /leaderboard, /labs/:slug, /labs/:slug/results, /rules, GET /attempts/:id and POST start/hint/answer(wrong)/answer(final), each deleted / nulled / type-swapped through page.route (fz.mjs, fp.mjs; about 1,000 mutated loads): every required field produced an alert or the 'server recorded your action but its reply could not be read' resync note; the only silent changes were optional/nullable fields by design (step.context, accuracyPct, bestScore, continue, vault, badge, fragment) and array element deletion/emptying, which a schema cannot detect. The R10 fault matrix (11 faults x answer/hint/restore/result/unlock/profile) was not repeated. Image load failure -> alert with Reload; sessionStorage blocked -> app still works in memory. Slow network (+2.5 s on every call, s21): loading/starting/checking states are role=status, controls disabled, axe clean. Confused user (s14): double-click on Ask hint charges one hint, double/triple click on Submit one answer, rotation 375 -> 812x375 -> 667x375 -> 1024x768 -> 375 -> 320 keeps the selected answer and hint list with no overflow; touch taps on the hotspot place the marker exactly (s23, 375/320). Forced colors and dark colour scheme (fc.mjs): selected option still distinguishable (thick border), axe clean; the app has no dark theme (renders light, readable).
KNOWN, not re-reported: R9-B-07 px sizing (so 200% text zoom was not tested), R9-B-08, R9-B-14, guest note, shared guest, carried-over XP. Observed and left unreported: after a failed 'Faculty guest' switch whose old token was killed by an in-flight 401 the page shows 'demo off' plus 'Your guest session is no longer valid' with a Retry that silently opens a new session (very narrow race, copy consistent); a stale lobby keeps showing 'Start' after a 403 refusal (the error explains it). Could not test: WebKit/Safari, real screen readers, real device sleep.
